description: Integration tests (full pipeline, determinism), package documentation (README.md with usage examples, architecture diagrams), and M1 completion report. Demonstrates end-to-end M1 Repository Discovery workflow: scan repository, build snapshot, validate, reconcile with legacy fixture. Proves determinism. Documents API contracts and extension points for M2. Depends on FEAT-001 through FEAT-005 (all discovery components).
steps: Create __tests__/integration/test-full-m1-pipeline.ts: (1) Instantiate FilesystemRepositoryAdapter with 'e:\\onlinewebsites\\quiz-platform', (2) Call buildSnapshot(adapter), (3) Call validateSnapshot(snapshot, adapter), (4) Call reconcileWithLegacyFixture(snapshot, 'apps/skillhubcore-admin/src/lib/project-llm/projectLlmRepositoryIntelligence.ts', adapter), (5) Assert: snapshot.structure.applications.length === 12, snapshot.structure.packages.length === 21, snapshot.structure.services.length === 3, snapshot.blocks.verified.length === 3 (I1, C1, D1), snapshot.composer.services.length === 1, validation.valid === true (or all errors are documented warnings), reconciliation includes 3 MATCH entries for I1/C1/D1. (6) Write snapshot JSON to .agents/tasks/m1-snapshot-test.json for inspection.

Create __tests__/determinism/test-determinism-proof.ts: (1) Instantiate adapter, (2) Run buildSnapshot twice (snapshot1, snapshot2), (3) Assert snapshot1.canonicalHash === snapshot2.canonicalHash, (4) Assert deep equality of structure/runtime/blocks/composer/dependencies/tests data (excluding timestamps), (5) Write both snapshots to temp files, compute file hashes, assert file hashes identical after timestamp normalization.

Run integration tests manually: pnpm --filter @quiz/project-llm-discovery test --run __tests__/integration/test-full-m1-pipeline.ts and confirm all assertions pass. Inspect .agents/tasks/m1-snapshot-test.json output.
Run determinism test manually: pnpm --filter @quiz/project-llm-discovery test --run __tests__/determinism/test-determinism-proof.ts and confirm hashes match.

Create packages/project-llm-discovery/README.md: Include: (1) Package purpose: M1 Repository Discovery for PROJECT LLM, (2) Features: D1-D8 scanners, deterministic snapshots, V1-V9 validation, fixture reconciliation, (3) Installation: pnpm add @quiz/project-llm-discovery, (4) Usage example: import { FilesystemRepositoryAdapter, buildSnapshot, validateSnapshot } from '@quiz/project-llm-discovery'; const adapter = new FilesystemRepositoryAdapter(repoRoot); const snapshot = await buildSnapshot(repoRoot, adapter); const validation = await validateSnapshot(snapshot, adapter); (5) Architecture: RepositoryAdapter abstraction, Scanner interface, Evidence model, Snapshot schema, Validator chain, (6) Extension points: add new scanners, add new validators, implement custom adapters (e.g., GitRepositoryAdapter for remote repos), (7) Testing: unit tests (pnpm test), integration tests (pnpm test __tests__/integration), determinism tests (pnpm test __tests__/determinism), (8) Snapshot schema version: 1.0.0 (stable for M1), (9) Determinism guarantee: same commitSha -> same canonicalHash.

Create .agents/tasks/m1-completion-report.md: Include: (1) M1 Milestone: COMPLETE, (2) Deliverables: @quiz/project-llm-discovery package with D1-D8 scanners + validators, deterministic snapshot builder, fixture reconciliation, (3) Verification Results: 12 apps discovered, 21 packages discovered, 3 services discovered, 18 block families documented (3 verified: I1/C1/D1, 1 incomplete: S1, 14 planned), single Composer confirmed (packages/db-tutorial/src/services/tutorial-composer.service.ts), dependency graph: 21 nodes, tests: vitest (unit/integration) + playwright (e2e), (4) Validation: V1-V9 all pass, (5) Determinism: PROVEN (same repository state -> same canonicalHash), (6) Fixture Reconciliation: legacy projectLlmRepositoryIntelligence.ts vs new snapshot: 3 MATCH (I1, C1, D1), 1 DISCREPANCY (S1 incomplete in legacy, implemented-but-not-verified in snapshot), 14 MATCH (planned families), (7) Snapshot Output: JSON with evidence traceability (all claims backed by file path + content hash), (8) Next Steps: M2 will extend snapshot with LLM-assisted semantic analysis, code quality metrics, architecture drift detection.

Update packages/project-llm-discovery/package.json: set version to '1.0.0' (M1 stable release), add 'description': 'M1 Repository Discovery for PROJECT LLM - Automated inventory, deterministic snapshots, evidence-based validation', add 'keywords': ['repository', 'discovery', 'snapshot', 'validation', 'evidence', 'determinism']

Update src/index.ts to ensure all public APIs are exported: RepositoryAdapter, FilesystemRepositoryAdapter, all scanners (D1-D6), buildSnapshot, validateSnapshot, reconcileWithLegacyFixture, EvidenceCollector, normalizeEvidence, computeSnapshotHash, all contract types (Evidence, Finding, ScannerResult, RepositorySnapshot, ValidationResult, ReconciliationResult)
